Thanks Elena — got the form and W-9, appreciate the fast turnaround. Looping in Markus (procurement) and Marissa (CS/onboarding) so we can align on the intake checklist and any temporary payment path.

Quick summary of our standard paths:
- Production subscriptions / committed capacity: PO required and created by the buyer (Redwood).
- Short pilots (typically <$5k/month or <$10k total) can be considered for an "invoice-only" temporary path, but require a short-form exception and evidence (W-9, SOC attestation if relevant, contact for billing).

Next steps I recommend:
1) Can you confirm expected total pilot spend and whether a signed MSA is available?
2) Please complete the attached supplier_quick_form.pdf (minimal fields) so AP has remittance and billing contacts.
3) Markus, can procurement evaluate a short-form exception for a 60-day pilot once vendor_quick_form + W-9 and SOW are uploaded?

We'd like to avoid blocker delays for the integration — Elena, if you can get the quick form and SOW by end of day tomorrow, we'll aim to surface an exception decision within 48 hours.

Best,
Chloe Martin

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Supplier intake: Fenway Payments - PO requirement question

Chloe / team / Elena — reviewed vendor packet and the SOW. Summary and decision:

- Pilot spend: $5,500 total over 60 days (one-off pilot).
- Risk assessment: Standard commercial SaaS integration; W-9 received; no sensitive data ingestion disclosed in SOW.

Decision (procurement): Temporary PO waiver approved under the "Small Pilot Exception" for up to 90 days, capped at $7,000 total. Conditions:
1) Redwood and Fenway sign the attached MSA (or mutually executed SOW under an existing MSA).
2) Fenway to complete supplier_quick_form.pdf and provide billing contact and remittance instructions.
3) Finance will create an invoice-only routing code: TMPNOPO-2027-05-FP. AP will accept invoices against that code; invoices must reference deal ID FP-2027-PILOT-09.
4) This exception will be reviewed at day 60 and must be closed (either converted to standard PO flow or canceled) by day 90.

Marissa: please proceed with onboarding tasks and confirm AP has the code. Chloe: confirm Fenway can sign MSA or countersign SOW and route final invoice instructions. Elena: once we have signed MSA + supplier_quick_form, procurement considers this cleared and finance will be instructed to process the first invoice.

Attachments to include in the Redwood record: fenway_vendor_form.pdf, fenway_w9.pdf, fenway_sow.pdf.

Markus Klein

Redwood Inference
